static_traits.name: Lin Fan
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends, but has not yet fully shared the anxiety about the garden with them
static_traits.medical_history: No experience of similar problems; has not received other psychotherapy; no major physical illness

basic_info.main_problem: I persistently feel anxiety and stress about the garden; if one rose does not bloom, I believe the whole garden will soon die.
basic_info.core_demands: When the anxiety about the garden affected my daily life and my focus on work and parenting, I decided to seek counseling; I want to try a gratitude journal and better manage my anxious thoughts, to see whether I can enjoy my garden without so much worry.

core_beliefs: Small problems will inevitably turn into big disasters
Things are either perfect or complete failures

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If not fixed immediately, a small problem will quickly spread into a bigger disaster, and eventually the whole garden will die
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly checking the garden, immediately looking for solutions, reading gardening blogs

special_situations.event: At work, being reminded of that rose that did not bloom
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once an abnormal sign appears, things will definitely get worse and worse afterward
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Difficulty concentrating on work, instead frequently checking gardening information or monitoring the garden
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Next it will get worse; all the plants may die

special_situations.event: Notices other plants are in good condition, but the gaze and attention remain fixed on the rose that has not bloomed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Problems are what matter; positive signs are unimportant
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring the fact that most plants in the garden are thriving, only focusing on problem plants
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This non-blooming plant shows there is a serious overall problem

special_situations.event: Most plants grow vigorously, but when one is unsatisfactory the whole is still evaluated as a failure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as there is one imperfection, it equals overall failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Explains the garden's condition with an 'all good or all bad' framework
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If one plant is not good, my garden is a failure

exception_events.target_problem: When seeing the rose that has not bloomed, the client usually thinks catastrophically, repeatedly checks the garden and searches online for solutions, with anxiety intensifying and affecting sleep and work focus.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Recently, the client saw the newly planted tulips blooming beautifully and noticed that most plants were thriving; their mood eased somewhat, and they did not fall completely into worry about that rose as before.
exception_events.reason: Different focus and situational clues: noticed positive facts in the garden (tulips blooming, other plants in good condition), so at that moment the client did not focus all attention on the problem plant.

positive_force: 对园艺投入与细致观察
Willing to proactively look for methods (reading gardening blogs, trying to fix)
Has some capacity for self-reflection and willingness to accept alternative perspectives
拥有少量可谈心的朋友
negative_force: Marked catastrophizing thinking and black-and-white thinking
Mental filtering leads to ignoring positive facts
Repeated checking and excessive attention cause exhaustion of energy
Increased work pressure and personal responsibility aggravate anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Shows strong anxiety when seeing the unbloomed rose and repeatedly checks the garden and searches online for information
antecedent: Seeing or thinking of that rose that has not bloomed
工作压力与个人责任增加
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizes partial problems, infers overall failure in an all-or-nothing manner, and predicts the worst outcome
target_behavior.function: Gains a brief sense of control and certainty through monitoring and looking up solutions, escaping anxiety and discomfort
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep is affected, work focus declines, interpersonal relationships are strained, and relaxation when spending time with the children decreases
